Korosten New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyrska oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This is the newer of Korosten's two documented Jewish cemeteries, a companion to the Old cemetery covered elsewhere in this collection. Its earliest tombstone, dated 1919, bears an inscription stating that the Jews buried there were murdered by Petliura's troops — a rare instance in this collection of a massacre's perpetrators being named directly on a grave marker. Another tombstone, transferred from the Old cemetery and dated 1914, also survives here. The site holds an ohel over the grave of R. Yehoshua Chaim Matusov, who died in 1938.
